title: Accession of Amenemhat I
summary: CFAH AP-53: accession of Amenemhat I (founder of Dynasty 12), 1738 BC.
description: CFAH AP-53: accession of Amenemhat I (founder of Dynasty 12), 1738 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 6: The Old and Middle Kingdoms of Egypt," ARJ 18 (2025): 13–60, Argument 2, Table 1 "Anchor Points for early Egyptian history" #53; Argument 2 "Dynasty 12"

chronologies.note: Jones (Chart No. 1; Chronology of the Old Testament, 2002) gives no date for this extra-biblical event.

chronologies.citation: Taking Africa for Jesus, ch. 3 "Egypt (Part 2)", PDF p. 28 (printed p. 28)
chronologies.note: A military leader named Amenemhet tried to form Egypt into an empire. Differs from the sort year (1738 BC, cfah-anchor) by 252 years.

chronologies.citation: Preparing the World for Jesus (2nd ed., 2024), ch. 9 "Early Egypt and the Exodus of God's People", PDF p. 185 (printed p. 171)
chronologies.note: Amenemhat founds the 12th Dynasty and builds Itjtawy.
